transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get the disposition review for Batch B-417 moving. As a reminder, the batch contains 1,200 molded housings and is currently on quality hold after the packaging-label printer outage. The dimensional inspection results are within internal spec, so on the dimensional side we're clear. Before I can approve the final disposition and close the batch record, I need to complete the routine checks with packaging engineering and the customer quality liaison. Could someone from packaging engineering speak to the label printer situation — is it resolved, and do we have any packaging or labeling concerns for this batch?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a packaging concern. My shift log shows that 240 of the 1,200 housings were packed while the printer was malfunctioning, and those units' labels are missing the required machine-readable lot code. Per procedure, those 240 units need to be relabeled after a 2-hour line-clearance and printer-setup job, followed by barcode verification. I completed the shift log this shift, but it hasn't been uploaded to the batch record yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a customer-side update that affects the disposition. I received a signed customer amendment this morning stating that the 240 relabeled housings may be released only after exactly 20 of them pass customer reapproval inspection. The amendment permits the other 960 correctly labeled housings to be released separately. I should note that I haven't attached the emailed amendment to the batch record yet, but I will do so once we wrap up this review.
transcript.speaker: A3

Jon to complete the 2-hour line-clearance and printer-setup job, relabel the 240 housings, and perform barcode verification per procedure.
Elena to coordinate customer reapproval inspection of exactly 20 of the 240 relabeled housings prior to their release.

Mara to approve final disposition and close the batch record only after the shift log and customer amendment are uploaded, relabeling and barcode verification are complete, and the 20-unit customer reapproval inspection has passed.
